description.value: Special attack listed in the source statblock: Whirlwind (Once every 1d2 rounds, 10-50 ft., 2d6+6, DC 21).

effect: 10-50 ft. whirlwind. Separate saves avoid damage and capture. Captives take slam damage each round; flying creatures may save again to escape.

description.value: Airborne creatures take a -1 penalty on attack and damage rolls against an air elemental.

effect: Airborne creatures take a -1 penalty on attack and damage rolls against an air elemental.

description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds, an air elemental can use its wings to cause a breath-like attack to slice the air in front of it in a 30-ft.- cone. Creatures within the area of effect take 8d6 points of wind damage, Reflex save (DC 17) for half damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 23).

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 23).

description.value: An air elemental shoots out a green arrow towards her opponent within 60 ft. The air elemental must makes a ranged touch attack (+17), if it hits, the attack deals 3d6 points of wind damage and knocks her opponent back 10 ft. (Fortitude save DC 17 to negate). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 2nd level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 19).

effect: Hit deals full damage; Fortitude negates 10-ft. knockback only.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 2nd level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 19).

description.value: Apply to airborne attacker only while attacking this elemental.
